# Edulari - Online Learning Platform

> Edulari is an online learning platform offering expert-led courses in programming, design, business, data science, and more. Learners can enroll in free and paid courses, earn certificates, and track their progress.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://edulari.zya.me/): Landing page with course search and platform overview
- [Browse Courses](https://edulari.zya.me/browse-courses): Full catalog of published courses
- [Course Categories](https://edulari.zya.me/categories): Courses grouped by subject area
- [About Us](https://edulari.zya.me/page/about): Platform mission, founder, and story
- [Help Center](https://edulari.zya.me/help-center): FAQs and support articles
- [Contact](https://edulari.zya.me/contact): Contact form for support inquiries
- [Verify Certificate](https://edulari.zya.me/verify-certificate): Public certificate ID verification
- [Track Report](https://edulari.zya.me/track-report): Look up the status of a submitted bug report
- [Track Ticket](https://edulari.zya.me/track-contact): Look up the status of a submitted contact request
- [Login](https://edulari.zya.me/login): Student and instructor sign-in
- [Register](https://edulari.zya.me/register): Create a new student account
- [Become an Instructor](https://edulari.zya.me/instructor-register): Instructor application flow

Individual course pages follow the pattern `https://edulari.zya.me/course/{slug}`. Individual instructor profiles follow the pattern `https://edulari.zya.me/instructor-profile?id={id}`. The full, current list of both is published at [the sitemap](https://edulari.zya.me/sitemap.xml).

## Features

- Expert-led video courses with structured lesson plans
- Quizzes and assignments to reinforce learning
- Course completion certificates with unique verification IDs
- Progress tracking across all enrolled courses
- Instructor profiles with ratings and reviews
- Category-based course browsing
- Free and paid course options
- Student dashboard with grade tracking
- Razorpay payment integration for paid courses
- Email and GitHub/Google OAuth authentication

## Platform Details

- Name: Edulari
- URL: https://edulari.zya.me/
- Founding Year: 2025
- Founder: Piyush Chaurasiya
- Headquarters: India
- Primary Language: English
- Payment Currency: INR
- Certificate Verification: Public, ID-based verification at /verify-certificate
